Regional Offices

MASLOC Is Closer Than You Think

Regional offices across Ghana deliver MASLOC services, programme information and application guidance — with the Accra Head Office at the centre.

Head Office

Accra Head Office

29 Third Circular Road, Cantonments, Accra, Ghana
  • +233 302 782527
  • +233 302 782528
  • info@masloc.gov.gh
  • enquiries@masloc.gov.gh

Full eligibility criteria and application guidance are available at the Head Office and all regional offices.
